title: Export sheet to a shareable CSV file
userStory: As a user I can export my receipts as a CSV file I can share from the app.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/exportShare.js exports exportSheet({csv, filename}, {writeFile, share}) using INJECTABLE writeFile and share (real by default, fakes in tests).
Filename is sanitized: strips path separators/traversal and ensures a .csv extension; empty or whitespace csv is rejected with a clear error.
On success it writes the csv to the resolved path and calls share with that uri, then returns { uri, shared: true }.
npm test passes with cases: writes to the expected sanitized path, share called with the uri, empty csv rejected, traversal filename neutralized.
